Itinerary

The weekend

A waterfall warm-up on the Friday, Yr Wyddfa on the Saturday, and a relaxed Sunday before the send-off home.

Fri1

Friday

Waterfall warm-up

Drive up and stop for a short waterfall walk on the way in to stretch the legs, then check in at Plas Talgarth for the night.

Group meetWaterfall walkCheck-in
A waterfall warm-up to open the weekend
Sat2

Saturday

Yr Wyddfa in winter

Wales’s highest peak at 1,085m, in winter conditions — an early start to make the most of the short daylight, then a full day’s hike to the summit and back.

Yr Wyddfa / SnowdonFull-day hikeSummit
Summit day — the roof of Wales
Sun3

Sunday

A relaxed day & home

An easy one to finish — rest the legs after summit day and enjoy a slow morning together before the send-off home. Sunday is kept open on purpose, so the final plan may change on the weekend.
